meta.title: Company Profile
meta.description: Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri is a company providing HVAC installation, maintenance, and servicing services in Indonesia

ihktisar: Building upon the rapidly growing business operations of PT Intisukses Mitra Sejati in the HVAC-R (Heating, Ventilating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration) and M&E (Mechanical & Electrical) sectors—and in response to customer demand for engineering support—PT Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri was established in 2017. The company focuses on contracting services, specifically installation, maintenance, and repair.

By steadfastly prioritizing customer satisfaction through rapid response times—backed by a skilled workforce, appropriate tools and technology, and support from principals—PT Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri has grown rapidly. This success is evidenced by the trust placed in our company (often referred to as IM2) to serve as a subcontractor or engineering dealer for various principals, including Daikin, McQuay, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, Samsung, Wika, and others.
IM2 has also earned the trust of a wide range of clients—including office buildings, factories, and luxury residences—who rely on us for high-quality service.
about.desc_office: A primary operational hub and logistics coordination center strategically designed to facilitate the smooth flow of inter-regional trade.

meta.title: AC & HVACR Installation Services
meta.description: Professional installation services for AC, VRF/VRV, chillers, and commercial heat pumps by certified engineers. Precise, clean, and fully guaranteed

instalasi.header_01: Performed by Experienced and Professional Technicians
instalasi.desc_01: Every AC installation is handled by trained technicians who understand safety standards and unit technical specifications. With experience handling various types and capacities of AC units, we ensure the installation process is quick, neat, and tailored to your room's requirements.
instalasi.desc_02: Throughout the partnership, we also provide maintenance services to ensure that air conditioners, water heaters, and heat pumps always operate optimally. This service is designed to keep the equipment in top condition and prevent breakdowns before they occur
instalasi.scope_desc: We execute every installation project through clear stages—from initial survey to handover—ensuring measurable and accountable results.
instalasi.scope_01_desc: Assessment of room conditions, piping routes, and electrical power requirements prior to installation.
instalasi.scope_02_desc: Placement of brackets and units in accordance with airflow standards and room aesthetics.
instalasi.scope_03_desc: Installation of refrigerant piping, power cables, and drainage lines with neat routing.
instalasi.scope_04_desc: System vacuuming and refrigerant charging processes based on unit specifications.
instalasi.scope_05_desc: Testing of pressure, leaks, and cooling performance before the unit is declared ready for use.
instalasi.scope_06_desc: Documentation of work results, operational briefing, and activation of the workmanship warranty.
instalasi.benefit_desc: A correctly installed system operates at its nominal capacity, consumes energy as designed, and reaches its intended lifespan. We ensure your cooling system performs flawlessly from day one.
instalasi.benefit_content: An improperly installed AC unit can lose 15–25% of its efficiency from day one. Correct pipe sizing and proper vacuuming save electricity and extend the compressor's lifespan.
instalasi.benefit_img_desc: Every installation is executed systematically following strict checklists and factory tolerances.
instalasi.benefit_card_03: Three fundamental principles upheld by our technicians during every residential and commercial cooling unit installation.
instalasi.benefit_presisi_desc: Every angle, level, and piping run is executed with millimetre accuracy. Precision machine-flared joints guarantee leak-free connections without vibration.
instalasi.benefit_kebersihan_desc: Work areas are protected with safety covers. Pipes and cabling are routed neatly to preserve aesthetics, and all debris is thoroughly cleaned upon completion.
instalasi.benefit_kebersihan_point_01: Protective dust covers for work areas
instalasi.benefit_hemat_daya_desc: Thorough system vacuuming, tight thermal insulation, and optimal placement keep compressor workloads light, significantly reducing power consumption from day one.
instalasi.cta_title: Ready to Install Your AC & HVACR System?
instalasi.cta_desc: Consult your residential, office, or commercial installation requirements with the certified engineering team at PT Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri.

meta.title: AC Maintenance & Servicing
meta.description: Periodic maintenance and preventive servicing for AC, heat pump, and water heater units by certified technicians. Clean air, lower power bills, and longer lifespan.

pemeliharaan.header: Structured Preventive Maintenance for Peak Cooling Efficiency
pemeliharaan.desc: We provide scheduled maintenance services to ensure your air conditioning, water heaters, and heat pumps operate at peak efficiency, preventing premature failures and maintaining healthy indoor air quality.
pemeliharaan.scope_desc: Each service visit is conducted according to manufacturer checklist standards, ranging from physical deep-cleaning to electrical audits and performance testing.
pemeliharaan.scope_01_desc: Removal, washing, and sanitizing of indoor air filters and unit casings for clean air circulation.
pemeliharaan.scope_02_desc: Controlled high-pressure wash of evaporator fins using protective wash bags and safe cleaning agents.
pemeliharaan.scope_03_desc: Flushing of drain pans and discharge piping to eliminate slime buildup and prevent ceiling water leaks.
pemeliharaan.scope_04_desc: Pressure washing of outdoor condenser coils to ensure efficient heat dissipation for the compressor.
pemeliharaan.scope_05_desc: Measurement of refrigerant operating pressure and compressor running amperage using digital gauges.
pemeliharaan.scope_06_desc: Testing temperature drop across supply and return air, followed by formal handover of service records.
pemeliharaan.benefit_desc: Micro-dust accumulation on cooling coils reduces heat exchange efficiency by up to 25% and strains the compressor. Regular servicing keeps indoor air healthy and energy bills under control.
pemeliharaan.benefit_content: Servicing every 3 months restores cooling performance by up to 99%, cuts electricity consumption by 20–30%, and extends equipment service life.
pemeliharaan.benefit_img_desc: Our technicians always use waterproof wash bags and floor drop-cloths to keep your room spotless and dry.
pemeliharaan.benefit_card_02: Energy Efficiency, Air Hygiene, and Unit Longevity
pemeliharaan.benefit_card_03: Three tangible benefits delivered by the preventive maintenance program of PT IMM.
pemeliharaan.benefit_efisiensi_desc: Clean evaporator and condenser coils optimize heat exchange, reduce compressor workload, and directly lower monthly electricity bills.
pemeliharaan.benefit_kesehatan_desc: Eliminates mould, bacteria, slime, and musty odours inside the AC unit, ensuring the air your family or workforce breathes is always fresh.
pemeliharaan.benefit_kesehatan_point_02: Eliminates musty odours and stale dust
pemeliharaan.benefit_keawetan_desc: Early detection of potential issues such as minor leaks, weak capacitors, or blocked drains before they develop into expensive major breakdowns.
pemeliharaan.benefit_keawetan_point_02: Avoids water leaks that damage ceilings

meta.title: AC & HVACR Repair & Troubleshooting Services
meta.description: Fast, accurate diagnosis and repair for AC, VRF/VRV systems, chillers, and commercial heat pumps by certified engineers. Genuine spare parts and official warranty.

hero.title: Accurate Diagnosis. Genuine Parts. Reliable Solutions.
hero.desc: Don't let malfunctioning air conditioning disrupt your comfort or business operations. Our certified engineers identify root causes and restore peak performance with genuine OEM components.
hero.imageAlt: Professional technician repairing an air conditioner

scopeSection.title: Common HVACR Failures We Resolve
scopeSection.desc: From small electrical faults to major compressor replacements across all brands and capacities.

scope_01.title: Comprehensive System Diagnostics
scope_01.desc: In-depth electrical, refrigerant, and mechanical error code analysis to pinpoint exact failure causes without guesswork.

scope_02.title: Compressor Overhaul & Replacement
scope_02.desc: Professional repair or replacement of locked, noisy, or grounded compressors with proper oil balancing and acid flushing.

scope_03.title: Refrigerant Leak Detection & Brazing
scope_03.desc: Nitrogen bubble pressure testing, electronic halogen sniffing, pipe re-flaring, and oxygen-acetylene silver brazing.

scope_04.title: Capacitor, Contactor & Wiring Repair
scope_04.desc: Replacement of degraded starting/running capacitors, burned magnetic contactors, and corroded electrical terminals.

scope_05.title: PCB Module & Thermistor Repair
scope_05.desc: Troubleshooting inverter control boards, microcontrollers, sensor thermistors, and remote receiver modules.

scope_06.title: Blower & Outdoor Fan Motor Repair
scope_06.desc: Resolving screeching bearings, seized fan motors, unbalanced blower wheels, and broken swing blades.

benefitsSection.title: Repairs Backed by Skill, Parts, and a Written Guarantee
benefitsSection.desc: Every job starts with an accurate diagnosis and ends with a warranty card — so you know exactly what was fixed and why.
benefitsSection.calloutDesc: Facing a critical cooling failure? Our technicians can be dispatched in under 60 minutes for urgent commercial and residential cases.
benefitsSection.galleryImageAlt: Certified technician performing AC unit repair
benefitsSection.galleryDesc: Every repair follows strict SOP and quality control before handover.
benefitsSection.guaranteeTitle: Three Reasons Customers Trust Our Repairs
benefitsSection.guaranteeDesc: Accurate diagnostics, genuine parts, and a warranty that backs our workmanship.

diagnosa.title: Root-Cause Diagnostics
diagnosa.desc: Digital pressure gauges and error-code scanners pinpoint the exact failure — no guesswork, no unnecessary part swaps.

sparepart.title: Genuine Spare Parts
sparepart.desc: Every replaced component is factory-certified, ensuring long-term compatibility and system reliability.

garansi.title: Official Repair Warranty
garansi.desc: We stand behind every repair with a written warranty covering both parts and workmanship.

stepsSection.title: 4 Steps from Diagnosis to Warranty
stepsSection.desc: We never perform unapproved repairs. Every step is documented and explained before execution.

step_01.title: Consultation & Symptoms
step_01.desc: Explain the issues you are experiencing (e.g., AC blowing warm air, tripping breaker, or water leaks) via WhatsApp or phone.

step_02.title: On-Site Diagnostic Audit
step_02.desc: Our technician arrives on site with professional testing meters to inspect pressure, voltage, and circuit board error codes.

step_03.title: Transparent Quote & Repair
step_03.desc: We present a clear breakdown of required parts and labor costs before starting. Repair proceeds only after your approval.

step_04.title: Testing & Written Warranty
step_04.desc: Continuous load testing to confirm steady temperature drop (Delta T) and issuance of our official written warranty card.

duration.q: How long does it take to install a single AC unit?
duration.a: For standard units (1–1.5 HP), installation typically takes 1.5–2.5 hours, depending on piping distance and site conditions.

material.q: Are refrigerant (Freon) and brackets included in the service fee?
material.a: Installation fees are separate from material costs such as piping, brackets, and refrigerant. Details will be provided after a site survey or confirmation of requirements.

warranty.q: Is there a warranty after installation or repair?
warranty.a: Yes, all work is covered by an official warranty of up to 12 months for installation services, with service warranties applicable based on the type of work performed.

commercial.q: Can you handle large-scale installations for buildings or offices?
commercial.a: Yes. We offer periodic maintenance contract packages for commercial clients with large numbers of units.
